shared_constraints: same supplied masked corpus, tasks, and ordered top-ten examples
no pretrained models, dictionaries, tokenizers, embeddings, or language resources
no network, external files, plugins, or cross-episode memory
protected evaluator is the only fitness source

founders.name: force-first clause planner
founders.hypothesis: Choosing clause force before wording prevents lexical retrieval from flattening commands, questions, assertions, wishes, and commitments into the same target pattern.
founders.decision_changed: Select a target clause-frame candidate using induced force, polarity, modality, speaker, addressee, and proposition slots before lexical filling.
founders.activation: At least two supplied rows support distinct target frames for English clauses with the same induced force signature and the query has a non-assertive or marked-polarity signature.
founders.fallback: Exact pre-GAR staged-harness candidate when force evidence is ambiguous or has fewer than two independent origins.
founders.falsifier: No clause-frame choice differs from disabled mode, semantic-role coverage worsens, or protected fitness loses.

genome.prompt: Research turn induces a small payload-local force inventory; translation turn realizes the chosen force plan then fills supported wording.
genome.skill_md: A six-step clause segmentation, force induction, alternative construction, realization, coverage audit, and fallback workflow.
genome.evidence: force_plan.json with clause spans, participants, polarity, modality, alternatives, and support rows
genome.fallback_policy: per-clause fallback, then whole-verse pre-GAR fallback

founders.name: illocutionary minimal-pair critic
founders.hypothesis: Payload-local minimal pairs can detect when a draft preserves proposition words but realizes the wrong interpersonal force.
founders.decision_changed: Accept, repair, or reject a complete draft based on force-feature contrasts with matched corpus pairs.
founders.activation: Draft and source disagree on at least one force feature and an independently supported repair changes only its realization span.
founders.fallback: Unchanged first draft; never rewrite content spans without a supported force repair.
founders.falsifier: Critic only produces commentary, repairs are not span-local, or disabled and enabled outputs are identical across all activations.

genome.prompt: Generate once, run a force audit, permit one localized repair pass.
genome.skill_md: Minimal-pair search and force-only repair rules.
genome.evidence: before/after force vector plus exact changed target span
genome.phase_policy: draft -> critic -> at most one repair
genome.fallback_policy: freeze draft if no two-origin repair

founders.name: field-tenor-mode candidate router
founders.hypothesis: A payload-induced register signature selects better attested realizations than semantic similarity alone.
founders.decision_changed: Rerank already-supported target bundles by field activity, tenor relation, and mode channel similarity.
founders.activation: Two or more eligible bundles tie on bilingual support but differ in register-neighborhood support.
founders.fallback: Original bilingual/retrieval ranking on ties, weak clusters, or missing dimensions.
founders.falsifier: Register labels do not break a real candidate tie or act as an unrestricted target language model.

genome.prompt: Infer three compact feature partitions from recurrent source contrasts, then use them only for eligible-candidate routing.
genome.skill_md: Operational field/tenor/mode induction with neutral cluster IDs and no imported language rules.

founders.name: register-conditioned evidence neighborhoods
founders.hypothesis: Conditioning corpus research neighborhoods on register reduces misleading lexical neighbors without allowing register to emit text.
founders.decision_changed: Choose which supplied rows contribute target concordance and construction counts.
founders.activation: Global retrieval mixes at least two stable register clusters and the query has a confident cluster assignment.
founders.falsifier: Neighborhood changes no downstream candidate, removes all useful evidence, or direct register gating repeats the harmful broad-authority pattern contrasted in [L0034#0@464849d2].

genome.prompt: Research both global and register-conditioned neighborhoods; translate only if their evidence leads to different supported choices.
genome.evidence: paired global/conditioned row lists and affected candidate counts
genome.phase_policy: cheap global scan -> gated conditioned scan

founders.name: recurrent-stage sequence inducer
founders.hypothesis: Local passage order reveals recurrent stages such as orientation, demand, reason, response, and closure that constrain a verse's realization.
founders.decision_changed: Choose among supported clause constructions using the induced previous/current/next stage triple.
founders.activation: A stage pattern recurs in at least two disjoint passages and stage conditioning changes a candidate ranking.
founders.fallback: Stage-agnostic winner when recurrence, boundary, or candidate difference is absent.
founders.falsifier: Stages are one-off labels, do not alter a choice, or rely on external genre knowledge.

genome.prompt: Induce recurrent passage stages from ordered vref/source/target evidence before translating assigned verses.
genome.skill_md: Stage segmentation, recurrence test, and stage-conditioned selection workflow.
genome.evidence: stage_graph.json with passage origins, boundaries, transitions, and candidate effects
genome.phase_policy: stage induction -> candidate generation -> transition-aware choice

founders.name: boundary-surprise discourse checker
founders.hypothesis: A draft that introduces an unattested stage transition is riskier than one matching payload-local transition patterns even when both cover the same propositions.
founders.decision_changed: Reject or locally revise a draft whose discourse connective or clause ordering creates high transition surprise.
founders.activation: Two complete supported drafts differ in stage transition and one transition has repeated payload support.
founders.fallback: Coverage-best draft; never invent a connective solely to satisfy a stage label.
founders.falsifier: Checker cannot point to the exact ordering/connective decision or merely adds discourse commentary.

genome.prompt: Construct two candidates only at a detected boundary, then compare transition support.
genome.skill_md: Boundary detection and conservative discourse revision.
genome.evidence: candidate transition paths and supporting passage origins

founders.name: provenance-weighted factor graph
founders.hypothesis: Explicit global constraints can prevent locally attractive bundles from duplicating roles, dropping negation, or producing inconsistent morphology.
founders.decision_changed: Select a globally consistent set of attested bundles under coverage, non-overlap, polarity, participant, and ordering constraints.
founders.activation: At least two locally eligible bundle sets differ in a hard constraint or independently supported soft constraint.
founders.fallback: Deterministic greedy supported-bundle selection, then pre-GAR harness if infeasible.
founders.falsifier: Solver returns the same set in all conflicts, uses opaque weights selected from fitness, or emits unsupported material.

genome.prompt: Luna supplies variables and support; deterministic tool enumerates bounded solutions and returns violations.
genome.evidence: variables, constraints, provenance, top solutions, and violation deltas
genome.phase_policy: candidate enumeration -> bounded exact solve -> verbal realization

founders.name: held-origin rewrite grammar
founders.hypothesis: Small source-to-target rewrite programs selected by held-origin description length can capture recurring reorderings without a pretrained grammar.
founders.decision_changed: Apply an induced slot permutation and affix/bundle rewrite instead of monotone assembly.
founders.activation: The same rewrite compresses at least two independent origins, survives held-origin MDL, and covers every query slot with supported material.
founders.falsifier: Programs memorize rows, lack held-origin compression, or exact skeleton matching makes them unreachable.

genome.prompt: Induce tiny rewrite programs, prove support, then apply only complete matches.
genome.skill_md: Program language, MDL accounting, and provenance rules.
genome.evidence: program text, code lengths, origins, slot coverage, and output diff
genome.phase_policy: cheap pattern opportunity -> held-origin induction -> apply

founders.name: counterexample-driven choice eliminator
founders.hypothesis: Actively searching the supplied corpus for a near-matched contradiction can eliminate seductive but unsupported lexical or structural choices.
founders.decision_changed: Remove a candidate only when a minimal contrast predicts its failure while preserving a supported alternative.
founders.activation: Two candidates remain and a corpus row matches their shared context while contrasting the disputed feature.
founders.fallback: Keep original ranking if no minimal counterexample exists.
founders.falsifier: Uses majority consensus rather than a feature-specific contrast, echoing the regressed broad consensus gene [L0014#1@5a0254f5], or changes no choice.

genome.prompt: For each high-impact uncertainty, state what row would falsify each candidate and search for it.
genome.evidence: candidate, disputed feature, counterexample row, elimination decision
genome.phase_policy: only top uncertainty receives contrast search

founders.name: retrieval donor with typed source edits
founders.hypothesis: Typing source changes as insert, delete, replace, reorder, polarity, or participant edits enables safer target-side donor surgery than undifferentiated similarity.
founders.decision_changed: Choose a donor and apply only target operations independently licensed for each typed source edit.
founders.activation: A close donor exists, changed source spans have independent target support, and at least one sparse edit changes the donor target.
founders.fallback: Unedited donor or pre-GAR result when any edit lacks independent support.
founders.falsifier: Requires exact cover, rewrites untouched context, or cannot reproduce donor when disabled.
founders.lineage_basis: Extends sparse provenance-gated surgery [L0018#0@b63b70c1] and retains its lesson that exact-cover activation was unreachable.

genome.prompt: Research typed diffs and independent licenses before drafting; translation executes the minimal supported script.
genome.skill_md: Typed-edit authority table and unchanged-context invariant.
genome.evidence: donor, source edit ops, target ownership, licenses, final diff

founders.name: source-coverage construction lattice
founders.hypothesis: A compact lattice of attested target bundles exposes ordering and boundary alternatives that a single early draft hides.
founders.decision_changed: Select a complete path jointly over source coverage, target boundaries, order, and provenance breadth.
founders.activation: There are at least two complete paths with different bundle boundaries or order and no repeated source coverage.
founders.fallback: Frozen structural winner; residual repair can run only after path selection.
founders.falsifier: Lattice is only a list of drafts, permits overlap, or character repair replaces a covered winner span.
founders.lineage_basis: Extends structural-first conditional repair [L0024#0@4d5a4e2d] by making the structural alternatives explicit before any repair.

genome.prompt: Research builds lattice nodes and edges; translation chooses one path then optionally repairs uncovered positions.
genome.skill_md: Coverage lattice construction and path audit.
genome.evidence: nodes, edges, source masks, path scores, selected path, disabled winner

founders.name: sequential uncertainty budgeter
founders.hypothesis: Allocating expensive research only to uncertainties that can still change a translation yields better decisions within the fixed two-turn budget.
founders.decision_changed: Choose the next research operation, stop research, or route to fallback using pre-compute opportunity and expected decision impact.
founders.activation: A cheap ledger reports at least two viable candidates and names a missing evidence item capable of flipping the choice.
founders.fallback: Stop and use the strongest currently supported candidate when no decision-changing query remains.
founders.falsifier: Runs every tool eagerly, spends effort on evidence with no candidate consequence, or timeouts rise.
founders.lineage_basis: Generalizes the successful pre-compute opportunity gate [L0048#1@e644f21b], contrasts the eager timeout [L0048#0@e9dda937], and treats causal inertness [L0049#0@e63fdac5] as a stop signal.

genome.prompt: Maintain candidate entropy, unresolved high-impact features, and a queue of evidence actions with explicit flip conditions.
genome.skill_md: Sequential research policy with hard phase exits.
genome.evidence: action queue, opportunity signals, expected decision, elapsed budget, exit reason
genome.phase_policy: cheap ledger -> gated action loop -> hard stop -> translate
